chunks: He who created the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them in six spans then assumed His authority. He is the benevolent: Ask those who are well-informed.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Ask those who are well-informed' mean in the context of Surah Al-Furqan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the doctrine of the Six Days of Creation, often interpreted as six epochs of divine unfolding rather than literal 24-hour periods. It underscores the necessity of referring to the 'Khabir' (the All-Aware), a title frequently applied to the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who serve as the authoritative interpreters of divine will and creation.
